records.body:
## 왜 필요한가

기존 warm endpoint·tangent 산출물에 이어, 이 샌드박스에서 끝까지 실행 가능한 H/He/Li number network 결합과 non-tilted LRS Bianchi I의 z=20→2 preliminary sweep이 필요했습니다. 이 PR은 REI source와 고정된 원자율을 재사용하는 독립 연구 단위를 추가합니다.

## 실제 완료

- 5×5×5 physical-axis main sweep **125개**와 별도 opacity-off control **1개**: 고유 IVP **126**, 각 193개 저장 시각과 62상태.
- 21상태: n; H1/D/T I–II; He3/4 I–III; Li6/7 I–IV. 전자는 charge neutrality에서 계산합니다.
- signed matter/radiation을 유지하고 합한 뒤 norm을 계산합니다. Frobenius/half-contraction, SI kappa_t, baryon pi=0 및 별도 massive Vlasov matter를 명시합니다.
- 원자망의 실제 ne가 photon Thomson 항에 연결됩니다. 별도 control에서 photon collision만 끄며 chemistry와 potential electron column은 유지합니다.
- 실제 PNG/PDF 5쌍, 125 endpoint CSV, 2,625 species row, 대표 전체 193시각 CSV, 모든 raw NPZ와 완료/실패 영수증을 게시했습니다.
- 준비된 momentum kernel, 벡터 연산, isotope scaling, 전체 62×62 analytic Jacobian, 가용 quota/RAM/공동 예약을 읽는 재개 가능한 dispatcher와 한 명령 pipeline을 구현했습니다.

## 실행과 검증

최종 `python code/run_all.py --execute --workers auto`는 4단계 exit0이며 main125/control1 모두 complete_reused, 새 worker0입니다. 최초 case는 적분/NPZ 저장 후 JSON NumPy-bool 오류가 있어 원 배열의 byte-identical 출력 복구만 했습니다. 원 실패/부분 JSON을 보존하고 알 수 없는 solver count/time은 null로 유지합니다.

81 frozen-state 최적화 parity, atomic 21 checks, coupled 15-direction Jacobian, runner 13 checks, 125 main 및 distinct control의 저장 자료·독립 검토가 모두 해당 유한 범위에서 PASS입니다. 독립 검토의 과거 dependency 저자 참여 범위를 명시하며, historical PR116 C6 기록은 바꾸지 않습니다.

상세 benchmark/scaling campaign=0, NCP 실행=0. 실제 sandbox는 CPU quota8/RAM8GiB였고 main launcher는 4 workers를 썼습니다. 기존 warm729/175/unified237/U4B/HE29는 재실행하지 않았습니다.

## 물리 범위

지정 T/UV, photo+case-A RR+DR number network의 **조건부 preliminary 모형**입니다. isotope별 electronic-rate 동일성, Li inner-shell 한 흡수→한 단계 ionization, test-fluid energy 근사를 명시합니다. n/T 초기 inventory와 실제 decay flux는 0입니다. CI/CX, full ionic/Auger yield, thermal/radiative/nuclear closure 완료를 주장하지 않습니다.

**Physical HOLD / global convergence NOT_RUN / production NOT_APPROVED / REC U5 HOLD_9_FAIL/HOLD_8_FAIL / CLOSED_HOLD_NOT_RESET / REI_activation=false 유지.** Draft이며 merge하지 않았습니다.

## 게시·보존

- 과학/실행 HEAD: `8509ef6ba713279134c98f9f47464aa879069755`
- 과학 tree: `15a8891913ae2a4a53654185d31929af1aef4050`

- 최종 tree: `a95e787efe4abebce514a6abd8377509ae042eee`
- 최종 **685개 remote Git blob SHA/크기 PASS**.
- 최종 archive: `REC_REI_HHLI_FINAL_20261021.zip`, **27,040,521 bytes**, 685 payload local readback PASS.
- SHA256: `5138e2bb9371c589299c4cef952bebf7bebb8486688522fa47a3afa0bc726f27`.
- Dropbox `id:BSpOijBcT10AAAAAAD_hpA`: ACK/size PASS; whole-byte readback **NOT_RUN**.
- 문서 마감 HEAD CI는 마지막 완료 댓글의 실제 상태를 따릅니다. Stage B의 역사적 EOF 빈 줄 실패와 Stage C 이전 in_progress snapshot을 보존합니다.

다음 후보 세 개를 비교해 **source-bound thermal/ionic-yield closure** 하나를 선택했습니다. 다음 과학 계산은 NOT_RUN이며, 완료 126개를 다시 적분하지 않습니다.

records.head: 04c0b10c1f1ec38d57c751369c553b638979e453
records.body:
## Why

The retained thermal closure in PR #121 does not include Compton energy transfer
or H/He collisional heating/cooling. A source budget is needed to choose the
next coupling work and keep source-domain limitations visible.

## Changes and results

This stacked research unit postprocesses the eight immutable full 63-state thermal
trajectories at 109 saved nodes each: 872 states, zero new ODE integrations and
zero old-IVP reruns. It adds actual-U hot-electron Compton, a separately owned
isotropic Planck reference, inherited dilute UV Compton exchange, source-bound
HG97 H/He CI and H I/He II CE, native availability masks and complete arrays.

On four primary paths, hot Compton removes 2.576–2.592 eV/baryon from z = 7.9637
to 2, equivalent to 29.72–29.92% of the existing primary photoelectron heat.
Supplied H I CE is about −0.00132 eV/baryon; CI moves about 2.05e−5 from kinetic
to binding energy and adds an electron. UV Compton contributes about +6.23e−5.
The directly integrated log-temperature forcing is about −1.03; this is not
a solved temperature correction or a rigorous omission-error bound.

## Validation

- 6 focused Compton and 10 collisional test methods pass, including independent
  cgs/SI conversions, Planck equilibrium, angular averaging, 9 actual 35-digit
  Wolfram CI fixtures, native conservation, particle/energy ownership,
  strict source domains, explicit continuation and absent-channel masks.
- Independent raw-NPZ recomputation of all 872 states agrees to at most 1.493e−14
  in power, 7.866e−14 in coefficients and 3.286e−15 in integrals.
- 65 implementation/provenance checks pass; actual source/result/trajectory
  hashes and all retained-grid arrays are saved. The first postprocess took
  0.6769 s wall; no completed IVP or old test suite was repeated.
- Three current PNG/PDF figures with exact plot data; actual PNG visual review,
  independent physics and implementation reviews, and explicit authorship.

## Scope and next step

Full CMB recoil/induced closure remains conditional on a supplied spectrum;
the Planck reference is not inferred from the actual moments. He I CE/
metastable and Li CI/CE remain unsupported. Fit continuation, missing channels
and underflow are distinct. 109/55/Simpson comparisons are retained-grid
diagnostics; RR-alternative sensitivity is not numerical uncertainty.

The next finite contract proposes 8 new full 63-state IVPs over two seeds, two
Compton branches and their nominal/refined pairs, with explicit test-fluid
gas/bath transfer accounting. Those future IVPs are NOT_RUN here.

Physical HOLD; production NOT_APPROVED; global convergence NOT_RUN;
REI_activation=false; U5 CLOSED_HOLD_NOT_RESET. This PR is a draft.

## Review entry points

Read REPORT_KO.md, THEORY_KO.md, HANDOFF_KO.md, NEXT_UNIT_CONTRACT.md,
results/budget_v1/RESULT.json and evidence review receipts under
research/rec_thermal_omitted_budget_20261022. Current figures are figures/v3;
v1/v2 preserve documented correction artifacts.

Publication and create-only backup are explicitly authorized. Remote commits
may have new headers, so exact Git root-tree equality and local/remote mapping
are recorded. Original local history is retained in the final archive bundle.


## Completed delivery

Final delivery head: `04c0b10c1f1ec38d57c751369c553b638979e453`; complete repository tree: `712f2c0ba224fbb902ec8b38f1fa1f53b4c5b4b7`. This is byte-identical at every Git tree entry to local final commit `3a5a853abb2eb0f67650288aa1cee82c576f9ffc`. Original local A/B/C/D commits and the prior thermal chain are preserved in the archive Git bundle. Stage C science commit `b423ca17b7ad782b33b62f95b82141ab237091f3` maps to remote `11897e09ea9368460ed074c0233afb924f39a7bf` at exact tree `022e31f6b7b0618fbd35c296850a8615ec9ce675`; the subsequent commit changes delivery documentation only.

This draft PR is stacked on [PR #121](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rec_bianchi/pull/121). No merge was performed.

`REC_THERMAL_OMITTED_BUDGET_20261022.zip` contains 889 ZIP entries (888 payloads plus manifest), including all 685 donor files, 106 prior thermal files and 95 files for this unit, a restore README and Git bundle. Size: **44,847,883 bytes**. SHA-256: `22922660598f5f808427b5776962db232c143892474c02864a22423d4157bad7`.

Fresh-directory restore audit: all **23 checks passed**, including payload/Git identities, saved-input and output bindings, current v3 figure files, bundle prerequisites, and import-only identities. No ODE, old IVP, postprocessor or test rerun was used for restoration.

The final archive, integrity sidecar and restore audit were uploaded create-only to the existing private Dropbox project folder; each returned a completed acknowledgment and then passed a full HTTP 200 download through EOF with byte count, SHA-256 and Dropbox content-hash equality. The prior thermal archive and this unit's Stage A/B backups also passed full readback. No public shared link was created.

Final delivery and upload receipts are external sidecars to avoid circular self-hashing. The committed `DELIVERY_STATUS.json` is explicitly the earlier post-Stage-C snapshot; this completed delivery record supersedes its pending final-archive line.

records.head: 8be7533cc97b3302bf42608699d6e8313ed6af8a
records.body:
## Purpose

The earlier warm729 pilot covered only a=0.1999→0.2. This branch adds a complete sandbox-runnable z=20→2 preliminary sweep with independently seeded matter and radiation anisotropic stress and retained H/He/Li isotope/ion populations.

## Changes and actual results

- Project the unchanged REC119 full62 RHS/Jacobian onto a proven reflection-even and equal-electronic-isotope subspace: **62 → 33 integration coordinates**, while retaining all 21 output populations and reconstructed full62 states.
- Run **125 grid cases + 2 initial-cancellation cases**, each with 193 saved epochs: **24,511 history rows**.
- Run two unchanged full62 oracle trajectories and compare them at the same epochs.
- Publish four PNG/PDF figure families, individual raw NPZ trajectories, exact plot-source tables, Korean report, DAG, and Codex/next-thread handoffs.
- Bound independent process workers by observed CPU quota/affinity idle/memory/peer reservations; one numerical thread per worker. Default resume verifies and reuses all 127 completed cases with zero new integrations.
- Repair NumPy scalar JSON metadata serialization without changing dynamics, solver settings, or scientific gate expressions. Preserve first-attempt failure evidence.

## Scientific scope

Non-tilted LRS Bianchi I; full Frobenius Sigma and signed split stress coordinates (half-contraction output also saved). Matter stress belongs to a separate collisionless nonbaryonic massive component; radiation is photon+neutrino; baryonic common-temperature gas has pi_b=0. The 21 declared states include n,H1,D,T,He3,He4,Li6,Li7 and their adopted nonnegative charge states through LiIV, plus reconstructed electrons.

Photo/RR/DR and electron-density Thomson feedback are retained under prescribed T(z) and an external 5–200eV UV field. This is a test-fluid preliminary model. Full thermal/radiative Q^a closure, CI/CX/molecules/secondary electrons/active thermal fusion/isotope-specific rates, general non-LRS physics and global convergence are not claimed.

## Validation

All 13 inherited gates pass for each of 129 actual cases. Fresh independent review: PASS_SCOPED_COMPLETED_PILOT_AND_RECOVERY; no blockers. Maximum paired errors: signed observable 1.20754e-9 (limit 3e-7), isotope fraction 2.92871e-8 (limit 3e-5), tau 4.30421e-11 (limit 3e-7). Raw-to-plot bindings, output hashes, all 21 abundance columns and the corrected cached resume were checked. No detailed performance benchmark or 64-core speedup claim.

Both initial-cancellation cases develop shear; at z=2 signed S_F is approximately -5.08317e-5/+5.08293e-5. The zero-seed control max|S_F| is3.189e-20.

## Reuse and delivery

Pinned REC kernel: a949529872eb5ba0e20c7e206fe893e5d544e48c. A closeout refresh found newer REC 126 unique IVPs with serializer-only change and HE 52-state preflight with zero science IVPs; these remain separate from the local 127-case accounting.

[Complete report](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/a6eda7e392a493bc92ecf532b0c835cbf7f6814e/research/rei_hheli_compact_pilot_20261022/REPORT_KO.md)

Stages A/B are published and provider backups acknowledged. Stage C contains 559 Git files; only two redundant large aggregate files are backup-only and reproducible from committed raw. Full C ZIP: 58,890,242 bytes, SHA256 c32c310ebffb9bfe1ed4b9b932265ccc069ef1c876c0529f1f89960f25aca310. Actual single GET verified size, SHA256,Dropbox hash, CRC and all 562 ZIP members. Final delivery receipts and the completed 30-node DAG are published in closeout commit 8be7533cc97b3302bf42608699d6e8313ed6af8a. The additional 17,136-byte receipt archive is backed up; its provider object and size are acknowledged.

This remains a draft stacked on ACCEL03. No merge or production/full-closure approval is implied.
